newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Austria's Meinl sees Budapest, Prague listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Meinl sees Budapest, Prague listing - paper.

text.p: Austrian supermarket chain Julius Meinl International AG plans to list its shares on the Budapest and the Prague stock exchanges, Hungarian daily Magyar Hirlap said on Monday.
The paper quoted Meinl AG director Johann Scheinast saying to a news conference in Vienna that the company will be listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) in the middle of July.
Meinl AG's Hungarian subsidiary, Csemege-Julius Meinl Rt will be delisted from the BSE, the paper added.
A BSE official told Reuters that Meinl AG had not initiated officially its listing, nor Csemege-Julius Meinl its delisting.
Csemege-Julius Meinl officials were not immediately available to comment.
On the BSE Csemege-Julius Meinl shares finished at 10,000 forints on Friday and remained untraded on Monday.
